title: My School
description: Practise there is, has got and can, and write a short description of your school.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: There ___ a big library in my school.
exercises.explanation: Use "there is" with one thing: there is a big library.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with have or has.
exercises.text: Our school ___ got a new computer room.
answers: has
exercises.explanation: Use "has got" with he, she and it. Our school = it, so: our school has got.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Our English teacher is very kind.
Is our English teacher very kind?
exercises.explanation: Subject + be + very + adjective: Our English teacher is very kind.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I can speaks French and English.
answers: I can speak French and English.
exercises.explanation: After can, use the base verb with no -s: I can speak.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Ms Green is ___ teacher. We love her.
exercises.explanation: Use "our" before a noun to show it belongs to us: our teacher.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Lessons start at half past eight.
At half past eight lessons start.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + time: Lessons start at half past eight.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: We don't go to school ___ Sunday.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with days of the week: on Sunday.

exercises.prompt: Write the plural of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: There are thirty ___ (child) in my class.
answers: children
exercises.explanation: The plural of "child" is "children".

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: My classmates are very friendly.
My classmate is very friendly.
exercises.explanation: Use "are" with plural nouns (my classmates) and "is" with one person.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I like ___ in the science lab.
exercises.explanation: Like + verb-ing: I like working.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: We ___ (have) English on Monday and Wednesday.
answers: have
exercises.explanation: With I, you, we and they, use the base form of the verb: we have.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My best friend don't like maths.
answers: My best friend doesn't like maths.
exercises.explanation: With he, she and it, use doesn't (does not) + verb: my best friend doesn't like.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: My school has got ___ old gym.
exercises.explanation: Use "an" before a vowel sound: an old gym.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We can't eat in the classroom.
In the classroom we can't eat.
Can't we eat in the classroom?
exercises.explanation: Subject + can't + verb: We can't eat in the classroom.

exercises.prompt: Write the word in brackets with 's.
answers: Tom's
exercises.explanation: Add 's to a name to show that something belongs to that person: Tom's desk.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My classroom is in the first floor.
answers: My classroom is on the first floor.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with floors of a building: on the first floor.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I like Fridays ___ we have art.
exercises.explanation: Use "because" to give a reason.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There is two playgrounds at my school.
answers: There are two playgrounds at my school.
exercises.explanation: Use "there are" with plural nouns: there are two playgrounds.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We play football after lunch.
After lunch we play football.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + object + time: We play football after lunch.

exercises.prompt: Write the negative form of be.
answers: isn't
is not
exercises.explanation: Use "isn't" (is not) with he, she and it: our school isn't big.

contentPoints: Say the name of your school and where it is.
Say what there is in your school.
Say what your favourite subject is and why.
Say what you do at break time.
task.modelAnswer: My school is called Riverside School. It is near my house. There are twenty classrooms and a big library. My favourite subject is art because I can paint and draw. At break time I play basketball with my friends in the playground.
